claims.claim: Po utracie telefonu zabezpiecz urządzenie, numer i zagrożone konta

quotes.text: Jeśli nie możesz znaleźć utraconego lub skradzionego urządzenia, dowiedz się, jak zabezpieczyć konto Google.

claims.reason: Backed by the Google snapshot: securing the device (mark as lost, lock) and securing the Google account. Not backed by any readable snapshot: securing the number (SIM or phone number with the operator; the Apple page is blocked) and securing other endangered accounts such as the bank (the Rzecznik Finansowy page is blocked).

claims.claim: Dostęp do innego zaufanego urządzenia i kontakt z dostawcami usług.

quotes.text: Oznacz jako utracone: powoduje zablokowanie urządzenia kodem PIN, wzorem lub hasłem.

claims.reason: Backed only for Android: the Google page gives the same advice (Oznacz jako utracone locks the device) and states the conditions under which the function is available. Not backed: the manufacturer's service for other phones, in particular Apple (page blocked); Google here is the Android system provider, not necessarily the maker of the phone.

claims.claim: Powiadom operatora o utracie karty i ustal jej zabezpieczenie.
claims.reason: Searched the Google snapshot for the operator, SIM or card, blocking the number and the phone number. The only operator line (120: the operator can use the IMEI to disable the device) concerns disabling the handset, not notifying about the lost card or securing it, so it is not used as a dependency. The Apple page, which the item cites for operator contact, is blocked (no snapshot), so this is a gap to fetch again, not a refutation.

The Rzecznik Finansowy page that would back this is blocked (no snapshot), so this is a gap to fetch again, not a refutation.

Searched the Google snapshot for police, reporting a theft and a report to authorities: the page mentions a stolen device only in line 172 and gives no advice to notify the police. The other two cited pages are blocked (no snapshot).

claims.claim: Nie czekaj na zakończenie jednego zgłoszenia, jeżeli inne ryzyko jest pilne.
claims.reason: Searched the Google snapshot for ordering, priority, waiting or parallel reports: the page gives no advice on the order of actions. The item's own Ocena dowodów says there is no study of one optimal order. The other two cited pages are blocked (no snapshot).

scope_gaps.note: The Google page covers Android and Wear OS devices only; Apple's description could not be checked.
The checked source covers Android and Wear OS only; the sentence does not name a platform, a reader may assume it also covers iPhones, which was not verified.
The item says 'producenta', but the readable source is the Android system provider's service; services of phone makers and Apple's service are not covered by any readable snapshot.
The Polish text of the Google page carries a notice that it may be AI-translated (line 186); 'oficjalne' rests on the page being a Google Account help page.
Absence was checked only in the Google article region; two of the three cited sources were unreadable.

notes: Opened only AGENTS.md, the role file, packet-verifier.json and snapshot 7d4296b28eab6e78.txt; nothing outside the allowed set was opened and no Grep, shell or network was used (CLAUDE.md was attached to my context by the harness, not opened by me). Two of three cited sources have no snapshot (Apple page: status 429; Rzecznik Finansowy page: blocked), so every claim that depends only on them is source_unavailable or, for advice, unsupported by the readable snapshot; the FAIL status comes from the unsupported recommendation rows W praktyce#2 to #5 and reflects missing readable evidence, so the two blocked pages should be fetched again before the item is judged on its merits.
